name: FastH3 Omni
note: [FastH3 Omni](https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Omni-8-Step-V1) is an 8-step distilled version of MiniMax H3 [ref2va] from FastVideo and Nuva Lab that generates video guided by reference subjects, objects, or scenes. Provide reference images through the canvas and moodboard, and identify them in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc. At least one reference image is required. The model generates 24 FPS video with synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. Start with a 768-pixel short side, 8 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, Shift 12, and Audio Shift 3.
